gitCommit.subject: Admin console: second step, enrolment, and step-up with a code
gitCommit.body:
Admin console: second step, enrolment, and step-up with a code

Signing in to /admin now asks for the code from the administrator's
authenticator (or a recovery code) before the console opens; with no
authenticator enrolled, it asks for the one-time token issued on the
server, shows the key (typed, or opened as an otpauth link), confirms the
first code and shows the recovery codes once. Every decision's step-up
asks for the password and a six-digit code, posts the step-up first, and
keeps the dialog open with the reason when it is refused; the decision is
sent only after. EN/FR/AR strings; console tests updated and new MFA
flow tests added.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
